SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. 1072
Date October 12, 1939.

Subject Enquiries re communist agent Fu Shing Tai (傅鑫推).

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao Hwa Forwarded by C. Crawford J L

D.
（印：SPECIAL BRANCH）

With reference to the attached enquiry on
Fu Shing Tai, a communist agent, who is understood
to have had close connections with the Chinese
Communist regime in Kiangsi and previously with the
Wuhan Group, I have to report that a thorough search
of the police files at Headquarters fail to reveal
any record of this individual, nor does this name
appear in connection with the publication entitled the
"Shanghai Courier" in the years 1927/1928.

According to information at hand, there was
a certain individual by the surname of Fu (full name
and pseudonyms unavailable) who was closely connected
with the Chinese Communist regime in Kiangsi and
previously with Borodin et al in Wuhan, but no further
particulars can be obtained.

Kuh Pao hwa
D. I.

D.C. (Special Branch)

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特务科第一股
报告
档案号 1072
日期 1939年10月12日。

事由 关于共产党代理人傅鑫推（Fu Shing Tai）的查询。

由督察顾宝华（Kuh Pao Hwa）呈报，经 C. Crawford J L 转递

D.
（印：特务科）

关于所附对共产党代理人傅鑫推（Fu Shing Tai）的查询，据悉此人与江西的中国共产政权有密切关联，此前曾与武汉集团有联系，兹报告如下：经在总部警务档案中进行彻底搜查，未发现有关此人的任何记录，且在1927/1928年间，该名字也未出现在名为《上海信使报》（Shanghai Courier）的出版物相关记载中。

根据现有情报，确有一名姓傅之人（全名及化名不详），与江西的中国共产政权关系密切，此前曾在武汉与鲍罗廷（Borodin）等人有联系，但无法获取更多详情。

顾宝华（Kuh Pao hwa）
督察

副督察长（特务科）
